features.title: IPC with 24" TFT color monitor

sections.text: The »ace« spindle accepts any attachment holder directly and without play via its ball bushing. You can insert the appropriate tool holders into the attachment holders and clamp them force-actuated as in the machine tool. The attachment holder is changed in 10 seconds with an accuracy of < 1 µm. The ROD rotation encoder detects the exact position of the C-axis.

sections.title: Optics with industrial camera

sections.title: Change what is preventing your success
sections.text: Top machines are running in your production, your team is highly qualified and motivated. What's missing is comprehensive geometry data on your tools and faster processes for setting up your machines. Time to change the future. Time for »venturion«.

hyperion.name: »hyperion«
hyperion.claim: The all-rounder with a focus on turning tools
hyperion.teaser: The horizontal presetting and measuring machine for turning
hyperion.headline: The indispensable all-rounder for turning operations
intro: Whether you want to set and measure tools for lathes, machining centers or milling centers - with ZOLLER »hyperion«, a single measuring device is all you need for almost all your different tool holders. The various tool holders are permanently mounted on a turret table, making them particularly quick and easy to use.

Whether you choose manual or CNC-controlled, with this device you are opting for maximum universality and will immediately benefit from a significant increase in productivity thanks to 100% prepared and tested tools.
highlights: Flexible turret table loading as required
A single measuring device for almost all different tool holders

sections.title: 20 % more productivity
sections.text: The universal presetting and measuring machines in the ZOLLER »hyperion« series guarantee maximum efficiency and flexibility when holding tools horizontally in CNC production. Tools of almost all tool systems are measured and set quickly, easily and reliably. This means less waste and machine downtime, more quality, more productivity - and more yield. In short: With ZOLLER »hyperion«, you can manufacture economically, on time, profitably and in perfect quality.

reamcheck.name: »reamCheck«

intro: With »reamCheck«, you can set complete machining tools such as long reamers and fine boring tools fully automatically, quickly, accurately and independently of the operator. The integrated control measurement offers you the desired safety.

The tailstock can be conveniently lowered using the operating handle and holds long, slim tools precisely in position with a defined contact pressure. Thanks to the outstanding ZOLLER technology, you can carry out all steps with ease and absolute process reliability.

torquematic.name: »torquematic«
torquematic.headline: Fully automatic clamping with »torquematic«
intro: With the »torquematic« presetting and measuring machine from ZOLLER, tools with collet tool holders can be set to length, clamped to a predefined torque and measured fully automatically without muscle power.
The automatic screw clamping station allows you to clamp tools without any effort at all. Your employees will be delighted!

features.title: Clamping tools securely
features.text: The clamping nut is screwed into the screwdriving station by rotating the »ace« high-precision spindle with dual drive according to the predefined torque and the tool is clamped.

features.title: »adaptYourHolder« quick-change system
features.text: With the help of the »adaptYourHolder« quick-change system, »torquematic« adapts to the shapes of the union nuts of your clamping systems.

tribos.name: »tribos«
tribos.headline: Mounting polygonal chucks with »tribos«
intro: With »tribos 600«, you can mount and measure the length of SCHUNK TRIBOS polygon shrink fit tool holders with μm accuracy. The device positions the TRIBOS clamping unit and controls the TRIBOS pressure control as well as the search run for aligning the SCHUNK clamping surfaces.
All automatically. Everything precise. Everything perfectly controlled.

features.title: Fully automated with »tribos«
features.text: The SCHUNK TRIBOS clamping unit is automatically moved to the clamping position and returned to the starting position at the end of the clamping/unclamping process.

features.title: Safely supported by »pilot«
features.text: The optimum interaction between the »pilot« image processing software and the TRIBOS clamping unit controller from Schunk ensures that the tool length is set with μm accuracy.

phoenix.name: »phoenix«
phoenix.claim: Maximum precision when measuring fine boring tools
phoenix.headline: Maximum precision when measuring fine boring tools
intro: Do you want to set your precision turning tools and reamers accurately to the μm in order to avoid rejects and reduce your tool costs?

Then you are ideally equipped with the ZOLLER »phoenix« presetting and measuring machine. With »phoenix«, you can hold your tools between centers and measure all parameters fully automatically using the snap gauge principle, achieving maximum accuracy for the best quality of your workpieces and longer tool life. For maximum efficiency and productivity in your production.

zenit.name: »zenit«
zenit.headline: Professional measurement of cutterheads
intro: Do you want to set your face and corner cutterheads precisely to guarantee the accuracy and flatness of your workpieces? Do you want to increase the service life of your tool cutting edges in order to drastically reduce your production and tool costs?

No problem with ZOLLER »zenit«: the high-precision presetting and measuring machine with ergonomic seat workstation for cutterheads and tools of all kinds increases the quality of your workpieces and reduces costs.

equick.name: »eQuick 200M«
equick.claim: Measuring crankshaft milling cutters and turning/turning tools in transmitted light
equick.headline: Measuring crankshaft milling cutters and turning/turning tools in transmitted light
intro: With the ZOLLER »eQuick 200M«, the cutting edges of crankshaft cutters can be ergonomically adjusted and precisely measured in transmitted light.

The measurement is non-contact and includes the Z and X dimensions, axial and radial run-out, cutter width and corner radii. The ZOLLER image processing »pilot 2 mT« also offers a cutting edge inspection for quick visual inspection of individual cutting edges.

gemini.name: »gemini«
gemini.claim: Easy measurement of crankshaft milling cutters and turning/ broaching tools
gemini.headline: Easy measurement of crankshaft milling cutters and turning/ broaching tools
intro: Setting crankshaft milling cutters and turning/reaming tools quickly, conveniently and accurately - no problem with the »gemini« presetting and measuring machine. »gemini« measures 120 cutting edges in just 80 seconds - with unrivaled ease.

The unique, fully automatic measurement in »focus 360i« measuring mode is a highlight of the proven ZOLLER image processing »pilot 3. 0« – and the high-precision measuring probe for axial run-out compensation makes complex measuring equipment superfluous. You benefit from the highest quality of your workpieces, increased productivity and complete documentation.

millcheck.headline: Measuring face cutterheads and cap cutters with unrivaled speed

A special measuring program also supports the operator in the photorealistic input dialog with the display of an additional analogue dial gauge. The fully automatic setting and measuring sequence guarantees repeatable, precise and fast results. This enables a high tool throughput - a clear economic advantage.

tms-starter.claim: STARTER: Getting started with the digital tool store
tms-starter.headline: STARTER: Getting started with the digital tool store
intro: The STARTER package of the tried-and-tested TMS Tool Management Solutions offers you the most important functions to quickly benefit from the advantages of digital tool management. Thanks to the modular structure of TMS Tool Management Solutions, you can expand your tool management at any time with the Bronze, Silver and Gold packages.
Access to all tool data

features.title: Storage location management
features.text: With the storage location management module, you always have an overview of your complete tools, tool components and accessories. The storage location management contains a virtual 3D kit with which you can quickly and easily map your warehouse in three dimensions and assign the items to a virtual storage location. Each item created can be managed in terms of stock, giving you a quick overview of the storage location, circulation and current stock. External storage and lift systems can of course be addressed via interfaces. Features: Quick warehouse overview Time saving due to elimination of search and shorter distances 24-hour tool availability Reduction in tool costs

features.title: Individual component management
features.text: The software module for the detailed creation of individual components creates a future-proof IoT basis for tool management. System detailed data: DIN 4000/4003/ISO 13399 Parameterization Technology data (cutting values) Graphical component representation 2D and 3D generation in accordance with DIN 4000 and ISO 13399 Import of 2D formats DXF/DWG/BMP/TIF/JPG/GIF/PNG Import of 3D formats STEP/STL Detailed data (e.g. cutting material)

features.title: Management of setup sheets

tms-bronze.name: BRONZE CAD/CAM Module
tms-bronze.claim: BRONZE: Additional efficiency with CAM interfaces
tms-bronze.headline: BRONZE: Additional efficiency with CAM interfaces
intro: The functional scope of the BRONZE package supplements tool management with interfaces to CAD/CAM systems. In addition to the economical management of individual components, complete tools, set-up sheets and accessories, you can use CAD and CAM data along the workflow. Optimize the CAM-to-part process chain with tool data.

features.text: Based on the individual components, the "Tool data management" function offers graphical and parametric tool assembly according to the tools actually available. This module offers a wide range of options: Management of accessories and parts lists Creation of where-used lists for individual components and complete tools Supported 2D formats: DXF/DWG/BMP/TIF/JPG/GIF/PNG Supported 3D formats: STEP/STL Automatic generation of drawings from individual components from the parts list (DXF with connection points)

With the help of import filters, platform-independent data can be imported or exported using postprocessors. Your advantages: Optional connection to third-party systems Process reliability Simple and fast handling thanks to simple structures

features.title: Catalog import of tool data
features.text: Imports tool data from many well-known manufacturers and cloud-based service providers (e.g. CIMSOURCE and GTDE) and can therefore quickly provide 2D/3D graphics, material characteristics and technology data. The tool data can be completed at any time and made available immediately via an export. Using the web service, third-party applications can access the shared database and import newly compiled setup sheets, for example.

features.title: Characteristics list according to DIN 4000
features.text: You can use the complete DIN 4000 characteristic list structure to define your individual components in accordance with standards. This guarantees a smooth exchange of information with external systems such as CAD/CAM and NC simulation systems. This uniform, standardized database is the basis for automatic tool data import. Your benefits: Time savings thanks to automatic tool data import Process reliability through error prevention

You always know what is located where, how large the stock is and can easily call up the tool cost figures. In addition to tools and components, the SILVER package also allows you to manage all operating resources such as measuring equipment, devices and NC programs.
Systematic management of individual components and complete tools

Interfaces: »toolOrganizer« »keeper« »twister« Third-party providers such as BCS Bamberger, Bedrunka+Hirth, Achterberg Toolbase, Gühring-Schranksysteme, Hänel, Kardex, Klingeisen, Lista LEC, Modula, StoretecStoreManager

features.title: Test equipment management
features.text: This module manages all your measuring and test equipment for the set-up sheet and monitors calibration intervals. Test reports are supplemented by informative graphics and improve the control of the measuring equipment. The logs can be saved to the measuring equipment as required. In combination with stock management, storage locations can be assigned to the measuring equipment and managed graphically.

features.title: Fixture management
features.text: This module is used for the modern management of your fixtures for the setup sheet and stores image information and setup instructions. Fixture variants are managed as parts list information. In combination with warehouse management, storage locations can be assigned to the fixtures and managed graphically.

features.title: NC Program Management
features.text: This module is used to easily manage your NC programs in the ZOLLER database for the setup sheet and offers the option of storing different program versions (version management). Information such as the clamping sketch, workpiece drawing and the solid model can be stored for the NC program. A standard viewer is integrated into the NC program management. Further option: Integration of an external viewer.

tms-gold.name: GOLD Shop Floor Management
tms-gold.claim: GOLD: For tool data, processes and key figures
tms-gold.headline: GOLD: For tool data, processes and key figures
intro: The GOLD package from ZOLLER maximizes the efficiency of your tool data management. You gain full cost control and transparency of your tool management across the process chain. With statistics on individual tools and orders, you control your costs, evaluate them and thus always make the right decisions.
Seamless organization of tool data

features.title: Parts management
features.text: The parts management software module gives you an optimum overview of your components and products. You can systematically manage individual parts and assemblies and document them, including setup sheets with the required tools. The module also provides additional information such as production times and current stock levels of the required tools. Features: A central database for all parts data Transparency of the production steps and the tools required Simple data management

features.title: Ordering system
features.text: Benefit from a practice-oriented and reliable ordering system with this software module. Order only those items that are actually needed in production. By optimizing your purchasing processes, you reduce your storage costs and avoid downtime due to missing items. This reduces your tool and ordering costs. By linking ordering and warehouse management, it is possible to automatically analyze minimum stock shortfalls and generate fully automated order proposals. Features: Reliable execution of orders based on minimum stock levels or purchase requisitions Automated generation of purchase requisitions Time and cost savings through optimized organization and transparency Automatic posting of the delivery to the corresponding cost center

features.title: Order management
features.text: The entire production process is mapped here, starting with order creation, storage and tool preparation, setting and measuring, right through to production.

features.title: Statistics module
features.text: You can use this software module for the graphical evaluation and management of measured values and data records in a freely selectable period in a variety of ways. The complete measurement statistics of a tool are displayed in a clear and informative tree view. The where-used lists of the individual tools are automatically stored in the system. This allows you to verify the areas of application of the tools at any time. A hit-flop list allows you to analyze stock bookings and goods receipts in terms of costs and usage, enabling you to precisely analyze and optimize your tool inventory. Features: Quick overview of measured values and measurement curves Traceability of tool usage Support for quality control in the production process

features.title: Tool life management
features.text: This software module for tool life management with integrated statistics function allows you to optimally monitor your tools and store tool change reasons. A process-specific configuration for optimum utilization of the machine running time is also possible. The statistics function graphically displays the tool life and the reasons for changing the individual tool stages and provides a clear log for a quick overview. features.title: 30% energy saving
features.text: With ZOLLER induction technology, you can heat your shrink fit tool holders optimally. For you, this means: evenly over the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This gives you shorter heating and cooling times, shorter cycle times, protects the tool holders and increases their service life. A particular advantage of »powerShrink«, with which ZOLLER is making its contribution to sustainable use in production, is the energy saving of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We are particularly proud of this. The heat and energy is used exactly where you need it to shrink your tools in and out safely.

features.title: When art hits the mark
features.text: Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER's Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrinking process. Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly designed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding slide past each other in a closed loop - a design experience. The ZOLLER uniqueness for unbeatable design and efficiency.

features.title: Flexibility in the blink of an eye
features.text: With the ZOLLER induction coil with shielding disks, you are opting for a simple, manual shrinking process for infrequent diameter changes or low variance. Discs with different diameters ensure that the coil's magnetic field is optimally aligned and shields it accordingly. The optional »shrinkbyLight« operator guidance system, consisting of the control LED for diameter monitoring and the status display for the coils, also increases process reliability when operating your »powerShrink«.

Tool cutting edges are in absolutely no danger of being damaged. You require absolutely no accessories such as a cooling adapter. In addition, your shrink-fit tools are cooled evenly along their entire length.

idchip.headline: The digital identity of your tool holders
intro: The ZOLLER »idChip« is a coded chip made of extremely robust plastic, permanently integrated into the tool holder. Its DataMatrix code makes every holder uniquely identifiable – at the presetting and measuring machine, at the shrink fit machine, in the tool storage and at the CNC machine.

This way you always know everything about your tool holders: number of heating cycles, uses on the machine and much more. Product service life, digital twin and further information are available anytime, anywhere – at costs far below those of RFID transponders.

The ZOLLER »twinPanel« guarantees the safety of your operators in the long term thanks to the quick and cost-effective replacement of the sacrificial screen.

features.text: Accepts almost any tool holder with an appropriate balancing adapter. Depending on the weight, the spindle rotates the tool at a variably adjustable speed of 400 to max. 1200 revolutions per minute and measures the unbalance with an accuracy of < 0.4 gmm. When designing the high-precision spindle, ZOLLER placed a particular focus on the safe and certified adapter changing process. A special design element prevents accidents and damage caused by unbolted balancing adapters in the spindle.

sections.title: Reach your destination with safety and speed
sections.text: »toolBalancer« makes tool balancing especially simple: thanks to the ergonomically designed »twinPanel« safety cover, convenient membrane keypad, compartment for balance adapters, and compartments in the large work area. The ZOLLER operating software with its structured graphic representation intuitively guides the operator through the measuring and balancing process. Using the appropriate software options, all balancing applications are available on 1 to 2 balancing levels, such as fixed position compensation with balancing screws or the use of balancing rings or balancing by material removal such as drilling or milling.

sections.title: From the center to the highest precision
sections.text: An unbalance on tools is caused by an asymmetrical design and the associated asymmetrical mass distribution. The ZOLLER »toolBalancer« solves this problem by using a deliberate center offset in the balancing adapter when measuring and balancing your tools. The balancing adapter with center offset is designed with a two-point system and a thrust piece. This results in a large and more measurable sensor signal and guarantees high-precision balancing results, especially with high balancing quality and low unbalance.

sections.title: Balancing means peace of mind for tools
sections.text: Vibrations occur when rotating tools do not run smoothly. Even at low speeds, this can lead to increased tool wear, loss of surface quality and additional stress on the machine spindles. Therefore, have your tools regularly checked on a balancing device from ZOLLER. Find out more about the advantages of ZOLLER Solution balancing.
